prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized faction banner. A rectangular pennant with a swallowtail
fly (two triangular tails cut into the trailing edge), mounted on a
simple vertical pole planted in the ground. Simplified app-icon
geometry: the banner is a single saturated palette color (a bold
primary), the pole is a thin flat dark line. The ground is implied
only by a simple small horizontal bar at the pole's base. No wind
ripple, no cloth folds — flat simple shapes.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat modern UI icon, Phosphor Fill register, single-subject centered composition on plain off-white canvas, bold vector geometry, crisp edges readable at 16px

SUBJECT: stylized faction banner — a rectangular pennant with a swallowtail fly (two clean triangular notches cut symmetrically into the trailing right edge), mounted on a thin vertical pole; banner rendered as a single flat bold shape; pole as a narrow flat vertical bar; a small horizontal bar at the pole base implies ground; no cloth folds, no ripple, no decorative marks inside the pennant

CONTEXT: isolated app icon, centered with generous padding on off-white canvas, no scene or environment beyond the minimal ground bar

COLOR: banner filled in bold saturated red (#FF0000); pole and ground bar in flat black (#000000); canvas off-white (#FFFFFF); strong contrast between banner and pole with zero intermediate tones

DETAILS: every edge precise and deliberate; swallowtail notches cut as sharp isosceles triangles from the trailing edge, symmetrical and clean; pole width roughly one-tenth the banner width; ground bar width matches banner width, height minimal; flat fill throughout, zero gradient, zero texture, zero brushwork

CONSTRAINTS: pure flat vector icon geometry; no gradients, no shadows, no textures, no painterly marks, no ink lines, no weathering; silhouette reads instantly at 16px
